game.q: the most feared man in kosala throws his sword away. why?
opts: the monk’s strange power spooked him
he saw a peace he’d never had, and wanted it

wrong.tired: he was winded, sure. that’s not it.

game.right: YES. not fear. longing. at last, someone had come to that forest for him.

end.line: he chased a walking monk and couldn’t catch him. then he stopped too.
end.l1: he couldn’t catch a walking man.

cliff.s2: his oldest friend weeps by a door. what comes next is the last lesson.

share: whole villages emptied out. one monk walked in. the angulimala story on infinite hill
